scenarios: shared native exclusion, own IO, compatible foreign opens, same-key CREATE during break and final-close lifetime
HANDLE recall permits cached close, while same-key sharing conflicts do not bypass access rules
classic Level II and lease grants retain independent authority over one native guard
expiry fences only that open; a fresh sibling keeps exclusion until acknowledgment
NFS reads and writes recall SMB lease authority before accessing shared file data
R-only invalidation releases native exclusion only after the matching notification is sent
same-key membership grants no extra file rights, caller authority or revocation exemption
